name: Reply Next
description: 为拥有数百或数千个实体地点的品牌提供统一管理和优化其数字化存在的AI平台,可自动响应客户、识别问题和机会、监控竞争对手
description_en: AI platform that allows brands with hundreds or thousands of physical locations to manage and optimize their digital presence from a single place, with AI agents that can respond to customers, identify issues and opportunities, and monitor competitors
why_matters: 针对多地点品牌的数字化管理痛点:90%的公司不知道门店通过Google Maps产生多少收入,70%的品牌不在公共渠道回复用户,不到10%的企业出现在AI搜索引擎结果中
why_matters_en: Addresses a critical gap for multi-location brands: 90% of companies don't know revenue generated through Google Maps, 70% don't respond to users on public channels, and fewer than 10% appear in AI-powered search results
latest_news: 2026年9月获得40万欧元pre-seed轮融资,由4Founders Capital领投
latest_news_en: Raised €400K pre-seed funding in September 2026 led by 4Founders Capital
source_title: AI platform Reply Next secures €400K pre-seed funding

evidence.quote:
Reply Next , an AI
platform for managing the digital presence of businesses with multiple
locations, has raised €400,000 in pre-seed funding. The round was led by
independent investment firm 4Founders Capital

Nine out of ten
companies don't know how much revenue their stores generate through Google
Maps, 70% of brands don't respond to users on public channels, and fewer than
10% of businesses appear in AI-powered search engine results.

name: Outerlimit
description: 专为AI代理构建去中心化安全和授权的公司,完成1600万美元种子前融资后从隐形模式中走出
description_en: Decentralized security and authorization company built for agentic AI, emerging from stealth with $16M in pre-seed funding
why_matters: 专注于AI代理时代的安全授权基础设施,在该细分领域获得1600万美元种子前融资(规模异常大),由AlbionVC、Evolution Equity Partners等知名投资方支持,表明市场对AI代理安全需求的高度认可
why_matters_en: Focused on security and authorization infrastructure for the agentic AI era, secured an unusually large $16M pre-seed round from notable investors including AlbionVC and Evolution Equity Partners, indicating strong market validation for AI agent security needs
latest_news: 完成1600万美元种子前融资,由AlbionVC、Evolution Equity Partners和Crane Venture Partners提供
latest_news_en: Emerged from stealth with $16M pre-seed funding from AlbionVC, Evolution Equity Partners, and Crane Venture Partners
source_title: Pair of $400m rounds drive this week's FinTech funding

evidence.quote: Outerlimit , a decentralised security and authorisation company built for agentic AI, has come out of stealth with $16m in pre-seed funding.
AlbionVC, Evolution Equity Partners and Crane Venture Partners supplied the capital
